Homework is one of the main ways you build the skills you need for exams: clear reasoning, careful units, and honest self-assessment.

## Solutions

Homework assignments use a **subset** of the practice problems from the lecture readings. Solutions for Lectures 1–3 are posted so you can review and self-check now; more will be posted later.
